One local team, all over the Metroplex

Salt of the Earth Cleaning Co. is a locally owned house cleaning company based in Richardson, and we clean homes across Dallas–Fort Worth, on both the Dallas side and the Fort Worth side. Big city or small town, every home gets the same detail-first checklist, the same English-speaking, background-checked team and the same attention to the baseboards, fans and corners that rushed crews skip.

You'll see your price instantly online, and payment is collected after the clean, not before. Recurring clients also get our limited-time recurring discount on every visit.

"If you want a cleaning company that truly takes great pride in a job well done, Salt of Earth is the right choice." — T. Rasmussen

Cities and towns we serve

Here's every incorporated city, town and village in the 11 counties that make up Dallas–Fort Worth. Cities that cross county lines are listed once, under the county where most of their residents live. Linked cities have their own page with local details.

Addison, Balch Springs, Cedar Hill, Cockrell Hill, Coppell, Dallas (including North Dallas), DeSoto, Duncanville, Farmers Branch, Garland, Glenn Heights, Grand Prairie, Highland Park, Hutchins, Irving, Lancaster, Mesquite, Richardson, Rowlett, Sachse, Seagoville, Sunnyvale, University Park and Wilmer.

Dallas neighborhoods and Fort Worth areas

In Dallas itself, we clean homes from North Dallas and Lake Highlands to Lakewood, Uptown, Preston Hollow, Oak Lawn, Oak Cliff and Bishop Arts.

On the Fort Worth side, our team cleans everywhere from Alliance and the north side down to Tanglewood, the Near Southside, Fairmount and the Cultural District.

What we clean, wherever you are

  • Standard cleaning: the every-visit essentials, done thoroughly.
  • Deep cleaning: the best first clean, top to bottom.
  • Recurring cleaning: weekly, every other week or monthly, with our limited-time recurring discount.
  • Move-in / move-out cleaning: empty-home cleaning before the keys change hands.
  • Pet-friendly house cleaning: extra attention on dog and cat hair, with pet-safe products.

Is my home in your service area?

If your home is in one of the cities above, or in an unincorporated neighborhood nearby, enter your address in the instant quote to confirm. You can also call (469) 210-8005 or email info@sotecleaning.com.

Do you clean apartments and condos too?

Yes. We clean apartments, condos, townhomes and single-family homes all over DFW. See our apartment and condo cleaning page for details.

When are you open?

Monday through Sunday, 8:30 AM–7:30 PM.
